  PROBLEM: In the "names" branch of `resolve_host_basenames()`, the `--module "${var}"` search and the assignment search both run over the caller's raw script text, so comment lines are never stripped. A commented-out `--module "${var}"` or `var=".../prepush_affected_tests.py"` line can therefore satisfy the guard.
  WHY: If a caller stops passing or assigning the real module but keeps commented-out copies of those lines, `test_scanned_host_file_matches_the_registry` stays green while the sandbox job tests a file that is not the one mounted. This breaks the invariant stated in the new comment, "a mention in a comment or log line does not count". Severity is disputed: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR, while minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT. The highest rating (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used here.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
